headline: US strikes in Iran hit airport, bridges and railway station
summary: The US launched a new wave of strikes targeting Iranian infrastructure, while Tehran responded by attacking US allies in the Gulf.
details: The United States launched fresh strikes on Thursday targeting bridges, a railway station, and an airport in southern Iran, marking the sixth consecutive night of American attacks.
Three people were killed in strikes on bridges in Hormozgan province, while explosions were also reported in Bushehr, home to Iran's only civilian nuclear plant.
In retaliation, Iran's Revolutionary Guards struck a US airbase in Jordan with ballistic missiles, citing an American attack near a children's cancer hospital in Ahvaz.
The conflict has escalated near the strategic Strait of Hormuz, with Iran threatening to close the waterway and the US reimposing a blockade on Iranian ports.
US allies in the Gulf, including Kuwait and Bahrain, reported missile and drone attacks, with air raid sirens sounding in Bahrain.
Government spokesperson Fatemeh Mohajerani stated that renewed US attacks have killed at least 30 people in Iran since last week.
While the White House says President Donald Trump remains open to diplomacy, he has warned that Iran will be held accountable for its actions in the strait.
caption:
US strikes hit Iranian airports and bridges as tensions explode over the Strait of Hormuz.

The United States launched fresh strikes on Thursday targeting bridges, a railway station, and an airport in southern Iran, marking the sixth consecutive night of American attacks.

Three people were killed in strikes on bridges in Hormozgan province, while explosions were also reported in Bushehr, home to Iran's only civilian nuclear plant.

In retaliation, Iran's Revolutionary Guards struck a US airbase in Jordan with ballistic missiles, citing an American attack near a children's cancer hospital in Ahvaz.

The conflict has escalated near the strategic Strait of Hormuz, with Iran threatening to close the waterway and the US reimposing a blockade on Iranian ports.

US allies in the Gulf, including Kuwait and Bahrain, reported missile and drone attacks, with air raid sirens sounding in Bahrain.

Government spokesperson Fatemeh Mohajerani stated that renewed US attacks have killed at least 30 people in Iran since last week.

While the White House says President Donald Trump remains open to diplomacy, he has warned that Iran will be held accountable for its actions in the strait.

headline_marked: Slovenia's Slavko Vinicić to [[referee Argentina-Spain World Cup final]]
headline: Slovenia's Slavko Vinicić to referee Argentina-Spain World Cup final
summary: The 46-year-old veteran will lead the title-deciding match at New Jersey's MetLife Stadium this Sunday.
details: Slovenian referee Slavko Vinicić has been appointed by FIFA to officiate the 2026 World Cup final between Argentina and Spain.
The match will take place this Sunday at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey, with Vinicić supported by fellow Slovenians Tomaž Klančnik and Andrej Kovačič as assistants.
The officiating team also includes Jordan's Adham Makhadmeh as the fourth official and Qatar's Mohammed Al-Khalfan as the reserve assistant referee.
Vinicić, who became a FIFA international referee in 2010, has a storied career including officiating the 2024 UEFA Champions League final between Real Madrid and Borussia Dortmund.
This will be his sixth World Cup match overall and fourth in the 2026 edition, having already handled Brazil-Morocco, Jordan-Algeria, and Mexico-Ecuador.

His history with Argentina is notable; he officiated their 2-1 loss to Saudi Arabia in the 2022 Qatar World Cup, a match where he awarded a penalty to Argentina but the team eventually lost their 36-match unbeaten streak.
He also has extensive experience with Spain, having refereed matches involving them in a 2017 friendly, Euro 2020, and the 2023 UEFA Nations League semi-final.
Vinicić has also officiated key matches for Lamine Yamal, including Spain's victories over Italy and France in Euro 2024, where Yamal's long-range goal against France was a highlight.
